args.question: Could you provide (1) the rest of the incident description — it cuts off mid-sentence ("damaged the side of the house near the...") — and (2) the claimed amount or an itemized estimate of the damage/repair costs, since no amount or line items were included in your submission?
args.reasoning: The incident_description field is truncated mid-sentence, leaving the actual damage unclear (e.g., "near the" — near the what? roof, window, foundation?). Additionally, both claimed_amount_stated and line_items are null, meaning there is no monetary claim amount to evaluate at all. These are gaps the claimant can directly resolve by providing the missing text and a cost estimate/amount. This is distinct from supporting_documents=false (which is a normal, complete answer for an estimate-stage claim) — here the core narrative and monetary basis of the claim itself are incomplete, not just unsupported by documents.
